Introduction.title: Systems Engineer | JS/TS, NodeJS & ReactJS Developer | Full Stack Developer
description: I'm a Systems Engineering, currently working in the industry of software development. I’m passionate about developing efficient, scalable, and impactful digital solutions. I enjoy tackling technological challenges, continuously learning, and staying up to date in a constantly evolving industry. I’m driven by the opportunity to work on innovative projects and collaborate with dynamic teams to bring ideas to life. I’m always looking for new opportunities to continue growing professionally and contribute my knowledge to the development of digital products.

items.title: Criollos de la Montaña

items.title: Distrito Joven
items.description: Institutional web portal developed for the 'Secretaría Distrital de Integración Social'. It highlights youth-oriented services and opportunities, including directories, news, workshops, and more.

items.title: Four Parks Colombia
items.description: Parking reservation and management system with admin dashboard and responsive user interface.

items.title: Hired Experts - Software Developer
items.details: Led the support and evolution of a full-stack web portal for clients of a debt law firm, built on a microservices architecture. Maintained and extended the frontend, implementing new features, fixing issues, and ensuring seamless integration with backend services. Managed infrastructure on AWS (EKS, ALB, VPC, S3) using Terraform, operating development, staging, and production environments on Kubernetes. Diagnosed and resolved incidents in a distributed system using Redis, PostgreSQL, and external integrations. Supported DevOps activities including Docker, Nginx, and deployments to EKS clusters.

items.title: Secretaría Distrital de Integración Social (Subdirección para la Juventud) - Software Developer
items.details: I contributed to the technical design and architecture of the “Distrito Joven” platform, developing admin interfaces and CMS-integrated features. I streamlined content deployment and publishing workflows, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure technical and visual consistency. I also managed code versioning and repository organization. The tech stack included ReactJS, Next.js, TailwindCSS, PayloadCMS, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

items.title: Freelancer
items.details: I built responsive web interfaces and custom admin panels for various projects. I implemented features such as content management, appointment scheduling, and subscriptions using technologies like ReactJS, Next.js, Angular, TailwindCSS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Node.js.

items.title: Bachelor's Degree Systems Engineering
items.details: Here, I had my first direct approach to the world of programming and software development. I learned the basics of everything I want to specialize in as a software developer.

items.title: First Line of Code
items.details: I wrote my first line of real code (my first 'Hello world!') that started my journey. I thank my good friend Yisus for showing me this world.
